title: Stranded Land
statement: A map grid marks land with 1 and water with 0. A hiker can walk between land cells that share a side and can leave the map from any land cell on its border. Return how many land cells have no walking route off the map.

answerKey.pattern: Search from the border inward: mark every land cell reachable from border land, then count the rest
keyPoints: Start BFS or DFS from every land cell on the border (multi-source)
Count land cells that were never marked
acceptableSlowerApproaches: Search from every land cell to see if it reaches the border: O((rows · columns)²)

hints: Instead of asking each cell whether it can escape, ask which cells the border can reach.
Start one search from all border land cells at once.
Answer = land cells − cells reached from the border.
